kind: Analytical native source-state compositions using emitted optical GLSL and substitute DejaVu fonts; no browser/CSS layout, motion capture or complete DOM screenshots.
limits: Source-state sample coverage is not full rendered workspace coverage.
Nested disclosures, toolbar controls and sidebars are bounded analytical representations.
Runtime glyph geometry is separately verified with substitute fonts. Native visual text measurements were not recovered from the two completed render processes.
PNG controls and dividers in this broad set use analytical alpha handling; their border contrast must not be treated as actual CSS compositing evidence.
An additional CSS-only envelope shadow correction followed native rendering; no emitted JavaScript or accepted shader was changed by that correction.
The final table-fact control styling is a CSS source repair following this native set; native table constructors do not reproduce its clickable DOM or selected row.
visual_inspection_scope: Representative source-state comparisons for all 29 supplied scene/page/system identities in Light/Dark at 390/1024, plus selected full-size and evidence-state comparisons. Every one of the 912 stills was not individually inspected at full size.
